ValidationRule.description: ID Numbers should be same, when ID Type is CPR Extract or Bahraini ID and Proof of Address Type is Bahraini Drivers Licence.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: IF( ((TEXT(ID_Type__c)='Bahraini ID' || TEXT(ID_Type__c)='CPR Extract') && TEXT( Proof_of_Address_ID_Type__c) = 'Bahraini Drivers Licence' && ID_Number__c != Proof_of_Address_ID_Number__c ) , true, false)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: ID Numbers should be same, when ID Type is CPR Extract or Bahraini ID and Proof of Address Type is Bahraini Drivers Licence.
